ambiguities_or_notes: Every source block (17) has a matching target block, with page markers, numbering, quotation structure, and italics preserved.

Website Circle of Reading paragraphs served as the first draft; each was re-read against the Russian and revised where it drifted (omissions, additions, generic he/his, terminology, attribution form); blocks 3 had no website counterpart and were translated fresh.

«Негр» (negr) is rendered with the period term 'Negro' as in the 1906 text, not modernized; «экю» (ekyu) is 'écus'. The attribution «Летурно» (Leturno, 'Letourneau') stands under the opening thought, and the paragraph after «Анатоль Франс» (Anatol' Frans, 'Anatole France') is printed unquoted; both are kept as printed.
Source observation: [3] The attribution «*Летурно.*» ('Letourneau') stands under the day's opening thought, outside any quotation; kept as printed.
